scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:phase2: pnpm run verify && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:workflow-reliability && pnpm run test:workflow-persistence
scripts.test:phase3: pnpm run verify && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:workflow-reliability && pnpm run test:workflow-persistence
scripts.release:check:persistence: pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:workflow-persistence
scripts.release:check:full: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run release:check:persistence
scripts.verify: pnpm run doctor && pnpm run contracts:check && pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run typecheck:workflow-core-tests && pnpm run test:workflow-core
